root_cause: External intelligence existed as useful but fragmented portal/source feeds. Without a canonical source universe and impact truth boundary, a catalogued source could be mistaken for a live connection and a generic external signal could be mistaken for company-specific or monetary impact.

prevention.existing_state_first: Reuse bg_signaal_onderwerpen, bg_externe_signalen, powerhouse evidence observations, Company Intelligence OS, canonical action/outcome authorities and the existing evidence-maintenance heartbeat.
prevention.source_truth: CATALOGUED means known capability only; CONNECTED/OBSERVED/LIVE require evidence.
prevention.impact_truth: External relevance can be scored deterministically, but company exposure and euro impact remain unknown until tenant/company evidence exists.
prevention.action_truth: Environment Radar creates review/recommendation context; execution remains owned by the existing Brain/action/obligation layer.
prevention.outcome_truth: Only observed outcomes can close the loop and create learning.
prevention.scheduler: Environment Radar refresh is added to powerhouse_evidence_daily_maintenance_v1; no second cron or scheduler is created.
prevention.portal: Portal V2 exposes one Omgevingsradar inside the existing Actueel & externe data group and keeps specialist pages as contextual drill-downs.
